title: Stepwise Config Orchestrator for cost-savings with SLO gates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a stepwise configuration orchestration pipeline that applies batching and KV-cache recommendations gradually behind enforced latency and throughput SLO gates. The orchestrator should propose an ordered sequence of safe config deltas (batch sizes, kv cache TTLs, async windowing) with automated runtime probes and rollback triggers driven by SLO violations and anomaly detectors. The goal is to capture 15-30% unit-cost reduction on eligible workloads while ensuring p99 latency regressions are prevented.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can generate staged plan for a given model/route with up to 5 sequential deltas
Runtime probes run pre/post each stage and validate p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput against SLO thresholds
Automatic rollback triggers on >2 consecutive anomalous probe failures or >5% p99 regression over baseline
Audit log entries for every applied delta with snapshot of config and reason
Can run in dry-run mode with a synthetic traffic driver and produce human readable report
notes: Initial spike completed: validated canary probe harness in staging using synthetic replay (see spike notes)
Trade-off: conservative default step size (20% batch increase) avoids p99 spikes but reduces immediate cost win; will parameterize per route
Decision: use hybrid anomaly detector combining EWMA latency drift + token-level throughput deltas
Risk: KV cache warmup may create transient bursts — mitigated with pre-warm probe stage
Next: wire SLO gate evaluation into rollout controller and add escalation notifications to PagerDuty if automated rollback triggers

qa_strategy: Run dry-run on 10 internal routes with synthetic traffic matching 95th percentile sequences
Compare baseline and staged p50/p95/p99 and throughput for each stage
Introduce artificial latency spikes to validate rollback behavior
Smoke test boolean flags and audit log generation
rollback_plan: Immediate automatic rollback to previous snapshot when rollback trigger fires
Escalation: on-chain rollback logs PagerDuty page to SRE and on-call PM
Postmortem requirements: collect probe traces, kernel selection logs, and rollout event timeline
implementation_notes: Use existing rollout orchestration infra (rollouts service) and extend API to accept staged deltas
Metrics: tag probe metrics with rollout_id and stage_index
Leverage existing batching advisor for initial recommendations but add safety caps per model family
Persist plan and snapshots in runtime-configs S3 path for reproducibility
open_questions: Should step sizes be uniform or adaptive based on historical spike probability?
Do enterprise customers get manual-only mode by default for Private deployments?
How to meaningfully attribute cost savings to a plan when multiple concurrent optimizations run?
final_deliverables: Console UI for staged rollout plans and per-stage results
Docs: runbook, design spec, SDK examples for programmatic use
